hr_spec_v1.frozen_since: 2026-10-25 (the X50 reads of 2026-10-20..24 ran on exactly these paths)

drift_reference.meter: species-usage TVD of full-six rated sides; accounts split into halves by a keyed hash, 20 splits; WITHIN = TVD(A_m, B_m); EXCESS = CROSS(m, m+1) - mean WITHIN (hrq.py drift_by_account)
drift_reference.superseded: the side-level split-half floor 0.009 (ignores repeat players, REVIEW A m1)

hr_arch_2026-10-24.source_class: (a) uploaded / archived replays (SKEWED vs the spectator stream, fd7f4624)
hr_arch_2026-10-24.rule: the manifest IS the definition (16,490 paths): the .logs under date folders <= 2026-10-24 that are NOT in the spectator manifest, as on disk 2026-10-25 (late uploads land in old folders, so the folder rule alone is not reproducible)

rowsets_schema: <snapshot>.r<n>: {snapshot, filter_spec, panel_exclusion_set (the held-out panels it excluded), rows_manifest_sha256, c_game_commit, extraction_commit, layout_hash, status}; a new held-out panel retires it
